topic.source_contract: burial authority, need, land, groundwater and flood risk, layout, legal approvals, access, operations, records and long-term management evidence

scope_guards: A burial-need forecast is not treated as an approved burial ground.
Land ownership is not treated as planning or environmental permission.
A groundwater desk study is not treated as accepted site investigation.
Planning permission is not treated as lawful operation under burial and cremation rules.
A crematorium design is not treated as emissions approval or commissioning.
A burial record system is not treated as available physical capacity.
Completed works are not treated as sustainable long-term operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact land, permissions, groundwater evidence, construction, operation and records.
row_checks: Current burial and cremation demand required
Population, faith and travel catchment required
Existing grave and cremation capacity required
Exact ownership and restrictive rights required
Exact operational and buffer boundary required
Source protection and groundwater vulnerability required
Current fluvial, surface and groundwater risk required
Grave depth, spacing and drainage required
Statutory separation and consent requirements required
Safe highway, walking and inclusive access required
Peak service demand and overflow required
Habitats, trees and protected species required
Burial or cremation legal requirements required
Completed buildings, roads and drainage required
Permanent burial, cremation and plot records required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
